candidate_grammar.boundary: Positive polynomial-side evaluations and exact rational brackets at supplied finite refinement depth.
candidate_grammar.generator: Exhaust representation, coefficients, enclosure, refinement, identity, reconstruction, generality and extra-rule choices.

excluded_inputs: semantic numerical zero is not an admitted value
negative magnitude is represented only by held orientation
irrational, imaginary and floating proof values are excluded
a completed infinity and an ungenerated continuum are excluded
intended_certificate: Independent regeneration of the complete candidate product, sole all-preserving survivor, closure properties, operational witnesses and controls.
statement: A magnitude not itself admitted as an irrational value may be identified by two positive-coefficient polynomial sides, an exact rational bracket in which their order swaps, and a generated bisection trace that narrows that bracket without ever importing the root as a proof value.
title: Positive polynomial-balance certificates for algebraic magnitudes
